# `WireEdgeGroupIssue`

**Kind:** class

**Source:** `src/graphrefly/_wire/bridge.py:39`

## Signature

```python
WireEdgeGroupIssue(kind: Literal['stale', 'gap', 'refused', 'malformed'], session: str | None = None, cause: int | None = None, last: int | None = None, missing_from: int | None = None, missing_to: int | None = None, reason: str | None = None)
```

## Description

A drop, gap, refusal or malformed frame at a group's gate (R-bridge).

``kind`` is ``stale`` (a cause at or below the last one taken; ``last`` names it),
``gap`` (causes ``missing_from`` to ``missing_to`` never came), ``refused`` (the
frame was refused whole; ``reason`` says why) or ``malformed``.
